profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp. describes itself as "The World's Foundation for Intelligent Operations." Its website says the company provides mobile computers, scanners, printers, RFID, and related hardware and software to digitize, automate, and enhance processes. It also describes manufacturing technology solutions with hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

The site highlights several AI offerings. Zebra Companion AI is described as providing instant, tailored insights and support for frontline operations. Zebra Frontline AI Enablers include AI vision models, sample apps, and APIs. Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints are presented as adaptable AI frameworks for automating manual tasks. The Zebra Aurora suite covers machine vision software for track-and-trace, vision inspection, and industrial automation, and Zebra Aurora Focus is an interface for setting up, deploying, and running fixed industrial scanners and machine vision smart cameras. The company describes its AI as an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

Zebra Technologies Corp. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, with ticker ZBRA and SEC CIK 0000877212. The available data lists 374 Illinois law exposure entries and no litigation cases. The company's site also notes that some content or images may have been created with the assistance of AI.
